question: shimei-4 is recorded with more than one father: ela, pedaiah-2.
note: The Hebrew of 1KI 4:18 identifies shimei-3 as Ela's son; 1CH 3:19 identifies shimei-4 as Pedaiah's son. Row 104682 appears to conflate these distinct people, but it is the project owner's ruling and must remain unchanged; the other relationships can stand.
